tasks.short: Provide technical expertise and support on manufacturing questions.

steps.what: Provide technical expertise on the manufacturing question
Gather the related process record for that question
Sign the support note that states the answer

outputs: filed copy of signed support note v1

tasks.design: An answer desk lists the process record in {DOCS} that matches the question. The engineer still gives the technical answer, signs the note, and a job files only that signed note. The desk does not send the answer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The record and the conversation were separate, so the same question was answered from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Process documents can be searched by operation and product without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A new question may have no record, and the engineer still has to judge it.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer is accountable for the advice, not the search.
tasks.altitude: The engineer still spends the week in the technical conversation. Search and filing shrink.

reach.task: Apply the signed answer on the line

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The process library is the source for citations.
Configure search on that library before a new store.
unknowns: Whether questions arrive by mail, phone, or the line.
Which answers must be kept as records.
research_questions: How often the cited record is out of date.

already_counted.description: The technical conversation stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Incorporate new manufacturing methods into existing operations.

steps.what: Study the new method against existing operations
List coded differences from the current process
Decide whether to incorporate new manufacturing methods

outputs: filed copy of signed method trial v1

tasks.design: A job lists field differences between the proposal and the routing in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer decides whether to incorporate the method, signs the trial in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version. A model does not change a safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparisons were retyped, and a trial could start before the difference list was agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: The routing is structured enough to compare required fields.
tasks.still_hard: A method can look complete on paper and still fail on the line.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether the method is fit for these operations.

ambition.what: Compare a proposed method to the live routing before a trial is booked.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the trial decision, not on retyping the routing.

reach.task: Run the signed trial on one operation

evidence.claim: Digest [S5] is cited for coded rule checks on records and plan reviews, so missing design fields are flagged before the engineer decides.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a machine safety function.

assumptions: Coded checks only flag missing or different fields.
Configure the routing record before a new store.
unknowns: Who may approve a trial on a certified line.
Whether the method changes a guard or a stop.
research_questions: How often proposals arrive without a complete field list.

already_counted.description: Studying the method stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review product designs for manufacturability and completeness.

steps.what: Review product designs for manufacturability and completeness
Check completeness rules against required design fields
Decide which design gaps block manufacture

outputs: filed copy of signed manufacturability review v1

tasks.design: Coded rules flag missing fields on the design in {DOCS}. The engineer reviews manufacturability, decides which gaps block release, signs the review, and a job files only that version. A passing field check is not a manufacturability decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completeness was checked by eye, so missing tolerances turned up on the line.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields can be listed and checked without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A complete drawing can still be hard to make.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether the design can be made as drawn.

ambition.what: Return a design the same day a required field is empty.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the review on manufacturability, not on hunting blank fields.

reach.task: Close the gaps named in the signed review
reach.learn: Which fields the rule list treats as required

evidence.claim: Digest [S5] is cited for coded rule checks on records and plan reviews, so missing design fields are flagged before the engineer decides.
The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.

assumptions: The rule list is maintained by the engineer, not inferred.
Configure the document store before a new tool.
unknowns: Which fields are truly required for this product family.
Whether a second engineer must sign.
research_questions: How often designs arrive in a form the field check cannot read.

already_counted.description: The design review stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find failure causes and recommend changes using statistical procedures.

steps.what: Determine root causes of failures from the parts
Run statistical procedures on the measurement table
Recommend changes in designs, tolerances, or methods

outputs: filed copy of signed failure recommendation v1

tasks.design: A job runs the agreed statistical procedures on the measurement table in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer determines the cause from the parts, recommends the change, signs it in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version. Generated numbers are not added to the table.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same charts were rebuilt by hand, and a chart could drift from the measurements.
tasks.enabler_now: Measurements are already in a table the procedures can read.
tasks.still_hard: A chart does not name the cause when the failure is new.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recommends the change in design, tolerance, or method.

ambition.what: Recompute the agreed charts when a new measurement batch is filed.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the cause and the recommendation.

reach.learn: Which procedure and batch the note used

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says root-cause work can use a dashboard and statistics on recorded measurements, with the engineer still deciding the cause.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: Procedures are the ones the engineer named, not chosen by a model.
Configure the measurement table before a new store.
unknowns: Which procedures the firm already accepts.
Whether the measurement system is stable.
research_questions: How often measurements arrive too late for the batch under review.

already_counted.description: Determining the cause from the parts stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manufacturing engineer spends the week on cause, design, and the signed decision. Collecting rows and filing a signed note move to a job.
reach: Quality technicians get a field list for the part they collect, instead of a blank request.
Planners wait for the signed note before they move a routing.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no source row.
Release only the version they signed, and leave a safety function to a person.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change note can open a controlled routing update, and the engineer still releases it.
